summary: Shows until applied per loop item, where items that never satisfy the condition fail after retries while others succeed, failing the task overall.
questions: Does until retry each loop item separately?
Why did my looped until task fail even though one item succeeded?

answer_card.title: until with a loop
answer_card.answer_md:
`until` applies to **each item**:

```yaml
- debug: msg={{item}}
  loop: [1, 2, 3]
  retries: 2
  until: item > 2
```

Items 1 and 2 retry and fail, item 3 succeeds, and the task fails overall with "One or more items failed".
